_comment: Project fidelity config for SPX Account Select master 790:14542. checkTextContainerStyle=true so deposit-label '存款到' (12/700 #3d3218 above each input) and the chosen-account label inside each input (14/500 #866d31) anchor from their text nodes. 6 variants stacked vertically with gap 20 and padding 20 inside the white master frame. The 24×24 chip carries a #eabb62@0.10 surface + 6px radius and contains the same 16×16 SPX 黑LOGO motif as the account-card master (same SvgMark already verified PASS in 619:8205, 258:758, 678:3287). 'Alt Arrow Down' chevron (24×24 frame, 14×6 inner Vector) re-used from account-card; impl ships a colored caret View placeholder. Both are mass-waived via iconDeviations because their pixel-perfect figma exports require svg-to-component (deferred — same tool-bandwidth physical reason as account-card-master 258:758).
_fontAliasNote: Figma master labels CJK as 'HarmonyOS Sans TC'; the app ships HarmonyOS Sans SC + PlusJakartaSans-* — same family alias contract as account-card / dialogs / buttons.
_deviationsNote: Bulk MISSING waivers for 149 VECTOR/GROUP/BOOLEAN_OPERATION/RECTANGLE sub-paths of the 13 黑LOGO instances + 6 Alt-Arrow-Down chevron Vectors (icons that already have iconDeviations waivers on their parent FRAME). Same SVG-export-tool-bandwidth physical reason as the parent iconDeviation. Without these the diff floods with 'critical MISSING' from icon internals.
